impact: Performed manual and automated testing across releases to ensure application functionality and reliability. Maintained Selenium, Cucumber, TestNG, and Java frameworks, improving test efficiency by 40% and accelerating test cycles by 20%
Designed and executed API test cases via Postman and Postman CLI, utilizing Swagger documentation for endpoint validation and integrated automated API testing into CI/CD pipelines using GitLab.

Conducted backend validations and log analysis on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to verify data accuracy, debug production issues, and executed complex SQL queries ensure data consistency across relational databases.

Created and maintained test plans, cases, data, and reusable automation scripts using Agile methodologies. Actively participated and collaborated with cross-functional teams to clarify requirements and mitigate risks.
Managed defects and quality assurance activities end-to-end using JIRA, ensuring full traceability and transparency throughout the QA lifecycle and provided final sign-off for production deployments
Collaborated with developers to validate Java Spring Boot microservices, focusing on backend API and business logic testing using JUnit integration tests for early defect detection.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines with JFrog Artifactory, managing deployments and artifacts; utilized SonarQube for static code analysis and quality gate enforcement to maintain high code standards.
Built and maintained Grafana dashboards for real-time monitoring of application metrics, test results visualization, and performance analysis.
Verified asynchronous processes and message flows using RabbitMQ, ensuring accurate queue handling and message delivery.
Collaborated with devops team for application deployment and server management in higher environments.
Developed automated web scraping solutions using Java and Selenium to extract data from legacy web applications and integrated JDBC connectivity for efficient storage into SQL databases.
Automated data collection, transformation, and loading from web sources into structured SQL database tables.
Created reusable Java modules to streamline the data scraping and storage process, reducing manual efforts and errors.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to analyze legacy applications structures for efficient data extraction
Monitored and maintained the scraping system, troubleshooting issues related to web page changes or connectivity
